X.note: This is a clean, untextured, game-engine-style block model. The roofs are huge flat slabs and the facades are smooth with little weathering. The coastline is a flat cut-out. The street is narrow and dark, and the shot reads as a mock-up. The architecture is vaguely Mediterranean, but it doesn't look like Main Street, Gibraltar, and nothing shows 1943 specifically. The frames are stable and nothing flickers.

Y.note: The composition is identical to X. The only visible difference is a little more grime and weathering on the left facade edges and the cornice, which gives marginally more material detail. The roofs and the coastline are just as flat and toy-like as in X. Textures stay fixed across the four frames.

why: The two renders are almost identical, but Y has slightly more facade weathering and surface variation, so it looks a little less sterile.
anachronisms_seen: flat concrete-style roof slabs and a modern, clean look
no period signage, vehicles or people to anchor 1943
